run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum length subsequence with adjacent element difference of 0 or 1
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify correct maximum length subsequence results
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming algorithm for finding longest subsequence with small adjacent differences
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a more efficient approach than the O(n squared) nested loop solution
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function for correctness and edge case handling with negative numbers and duplicates
